name: Network and Distributed System Security Symposium (NDSS)
description: Leading security forum fostering information exchange among researchers and practitioners of network and distributed system security.

peerReview.processDescription: Double-blind peer review process. Program committee of 50-60 experts. Multiple review rounds. Author rebuttal phase. Strict conflict of interest management. Papers submitted via OpenReview.

attribution.attributionNotes: Published in NDSS proceedings (indexed, citable). Test of Time Awards. Best Paper Awards. Speaker certificates.

povsAlignment.description: Top-tier academic conference with double-blind peer review and indexed proceedings.
